name: breeder_liner
description: PUMP pressure column + DMND liner with a CLNE(DEUT) breeder every N rows -- place one on each chamber wall.
why: Save1 'how it works' #2-3: CLNE(DEUT) cells along the DMND liners keep re-breeding DEUT so the fuel never runs out; the PUMP column beside the liner holds the chamber positive so the reaction rate scales with pressure (PUMP+VACU pressure pair is the existing pressure_chamber module -- this adds the self-breeding fuel wall pressure_chamber does not provide). blueprint_lint flags the PUMP column as unwalled (pump_vacu_no_wall); accepted by design -- this module is meant to be placed flanking a pressure_chamber's fill region (as save1 does, mirrored on both sides), and it is pressure_chamber's own wall frame that encloses the PUMP once composed, not this liner alone.
source: save1, reaction chamber x232-283 y244-275 (PUMP columns x232-235/280-283, DMND liners, CLNE(DEUT) every 5 rows)
